amendments.normalized_body: The `colonizable_area_factor` valid_range upper bound for `coarse_porous.toml` is 1.1, which would mean colonizable area exceeds geometric footprint. Add a brief note in the `param_meta.notes` field explaining why >1.0 is physically meaningful for porous media (surface area exceeding projected area due to void structure) or tighten the upper bound to 1.0 if it should not exceed footprint.

In `docs/PROVENANCE_STATUS.md`, the code-resident solver constants table lists `pKa1(T)` as a formula row but uses a different format from the other rows (inline formula vs. single numeric value). Add an explicit 25°C reference value (≈6.35) alongside the formula for quick cross-referencing with standard carbonate tables, consistent with how `PKA2` is presented.

Remove `temp_condition_low_divisor_c` and `temp_condition_high_divisor_c` from the `<= 1.0` validator bucket in `/home/master/p/tank-simulation/crates/tank_data/src/presets.rs:1051-1056` and `/home/master/p/tank-simulation/crates/tank_data/src/presets.rs:1135-1139`. These fields are positive Celsius spans with shipped values `10.0` and `8.0` in `/home/master/p/tank-simulation/crates/tank_data/data/shrimp/neocaridina_davidi.toml:36-37`, so the current validation rejects the default shrimp preset and prevents scenario materialization.

Make the new NH3 stress tuning actually affect the molt-stress path, or narrow the contract/docs to match the implementation. `/home/master/p/tank-simulation/crates/tank_core/src/types/biology.rs:432-435` says `nh3_stress_response_scale` routes hourly NH3 stress into the mortality and molt-stress channels, and `/home/master/p/tank-simulation/crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs:123-128` now parameterizes NH3 accumulation, but `/home/master/p/tank-simulation/crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs:504-505` still builds `hourly_pressure` from heat and instability only. As shipped, changing the new NH3 parameters cannot directly change `molt_stress_index`, warning emission, or molt failure pressure.

Add `param_meta` entries or explicit provisional/TODO notes for the newly introduced shrimp tunables in `/home/master/p/tank-simulation/crates/tank_data/data/shrimp/neocaridina_davidi.toml:36-60`. The file now exposes `temp_condition_low_divisor_c`, `temp_condition_high_divisor_c`, `molt_stress_condition_midpoint`, `molt_stress_thermal_cap`, `nh3_stress_threshold_mg_n_per_l`, and `nh3_stress_response_scale` as first-class scientific knobs, but the `param_meta` section starting at `/home/master/p/tank-simulation/crates/tank_data/data/shrimp/neocaridina_davidi.toml:98` contains no provenance/confidence entries for them.
